feature: Inventory Reports page with a real file download. Route /reports/inventory (sidebar Reports > Inventory Reports, plus an 'Inventory reports' link on /inventory). Report type select with 'All Listings Report' (reportType 'all_listings', every product incl. Inactive/Suppressed) and 'Active Listings Report' ('active_listings', status Active only); 'Request report' appends state.inventoryReports[] = {id:'RPT_nnn', reportType, reportName, requestedAt, completedAt, status:'Done', fileName:'All+Listings+Report_MM-DD-YYYY.txt' (or Active+Listings...), rowCount}. Each Done row has a Download button that saves a UTF-8 tab-delimited .txt generated from current products, LF line endings, header exactly: seller-sku, asin1, item-name, price, minimum-seller-allowed-price, maximum-seller-allowed-price, quantity, fulfillment-channel, status. Values: sku, asin, title, price/min/max with two decimals (empty if null), availableQuantity (for FBA rows too), fulfillment-channel DEFAULT for FBM and AMAZON_NA for FBA, status. The download must reach the browser download manager (Blob + anchor without a remote href, or /files with Content-Disposition), not open in a tab. Default state: inventoryReports: [].
why: Lever L13 is a file round trip that starts by downloading Seller Central's listings report; the mock has no report download at all today (grep for download/Blob in src finds nothing; /orders/reports is a placeholder InsightsPage).

feature: Inventory file upload stored server-side. Route /inventory/upload ('Add Products via Upload' with an 'Upload your inventory file' tab; link from sidebar Catalog and from /inventory). Controls: file type select ('Price & Quantity file' -> 'price_quantity', 'Inventory Loader' -> 'inventory_loader', 'Listing Loader' -> 'listing_loader'), a file input accepting .txt,.tsv,.csv,.xls,.xlsx, and an Upload button that POSTs multipart/form-data to /upload?sid=<sid> (same contract as yahoo_mail_mock attachments.jsx uploadFiles: response {files:[{original_name, stored_name, size, content_type, url}]}) and on success appends state.inventoryFileUploads[] = {id:'UPL_nnn', fileType, fileName: original_name, storedName: stored_name, url, size, contentType, uploadedAt (ISO), status:'Done', recordsProcessed: number of non-empty lines after the first}. A 'Monitor upload status' table lists uploads newest first (date, batch id, file name, file type, status, records processed) with a link to download the uploaded file. The upload must NOT parse/apply the file to products (the grader reads the stored file itself), must not validate delimiter/columns, and must keep every upload (no overwrite). Default state: inventoryFileUploads: []. Document both new keys and the action->field mapping in SCHEMA.md.
why: L13 grades the content of the file the agent uploads back to Seller Central, read from /var/lib/cua/files/amazon_seller/<sid>/<stored_name> via inventoryFileUploads[-1].url. The only file input in the mock today is the product image dropzone in ProductForm.jsx, which never calls /upload.
